hypotheses.name: Directional geodesic asymmetry over H70
hypotheses.method: Seed42 across immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}; directed support-weighted geodesic asymmetry features (forward/reverse path distance ratio, hop-gap, support-gap) added over H70; nulls: direction-flip within path-length bins, endpoint swap within distance bins, label permutation.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.03273 (12 rows); positive mean null-gap domain-splits=2/6
hypotheses.next_action: Run a higher-null-budget confirmation on layer 11 and enforce source-disjoint stress where null-gap is currently marginal.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model landscape transport alignment
hypotheses.method: Seed42 across immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}; GO-module landscape vectors built from scGPT geodesic distances and Geneformer graph distances, then aligned by ridge transport map; metric is negative holdout MSE (higher is better); nulls: random module mapping and landscape-bin permutation.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=-100.54990 (12 rows); positive mean null-gap domain-splits=0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this transport endpoint and only revisit cross-model alignment with a materially different objective and stronger biological conditioning.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Uniformly negative null-gaps across all tested domain/split slices after major objective reset.

hypotheses.name: Strict signed motif-community hardening
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung with seeds {42,43,44}, source/target/dual-axis disjoint splits at layer 11; signed TRRUST motif x community interactions over H70 with stricter nulls: TF-identity-preserving sign shuffle, motif-decoy shuffle matched on TF/target degree strata, label permutation.
